fills.value: Tower Houses replace Outposts, can produce Highland Cattle and Ghillies, and raise the population cap.

fills.name: Highland Wealth
fills.value: Protect Highland Cattle grazing in berry bushes; they provide food continuously as they eat. Herd capacity increases with each Highland landmark built.

fills.name: Highland Ambush
fills.value: Infantry have a deep knowledge of and connection to the land, gaining advantages when fighting in and around Dense Forests. They ignore the sight penalty when entering Dense Forests and gain movement speed while Highland Ambush is active.
fills.quote: 高地伏击 步兵对土地有深厚的了解与联系，在浓密森林内外作战时具有优势。进入浓密森林时无视视野惩罚，且高地伏击激活时移动速度提升。

fills.note: overview heading 应召而战 (Answer the Call); translated from Chinese

fills.name: Castle Ruins
fills.value: When a Keep is destroyed it uses scorched-earth tactics, damaging the surrounding area for a time. Enemies in the area have their combat ability temporarily reduced. The Keep becomes Castle Ruins, which can be repaired in time to avoid total destruction. Castle Ruins can be fully repaired for at most 600 stone; repairs after that are free.
